iconDescription: Choose a real launcher icon for Dream Diary. Your launcher may take a moment to refresh and may apply its own shape or themed-icon treatment.
iconApplied: Icon updated. Your launcher may take a moment to refresh.
iconError: Could not update the icon. Check that the image is valid and your launcher allows shortcuts.
iconTooLarge: Choose an image smaller than 20 MB.
iconMonochromeHint: Android 13+ themed icons use the bundled monochrome layer. The preview is approximate.
iconCropHint: Drag to reposition and use the slider to zoom. The original image is never changed.
shortcutDescription: Use a photo from your files as an additional home-screen shortcut. This does not replace the main launcher icon.
shortcutRequested: Shortcut request sent. Confirm it in your launcher if prompted.
shortcutDeclined: Your launcher did not accept the shortcut request. The main icon is unchanged.
shortcutRemoveMessage: Disable this shortcut and delete only the private copy. Your original image is kept.
shortcutLimit: Some launchers keep their own shortcut style or do not allow pinning. Existing Moodiary shortcuts may need to be added again after this fork update. Removing the app removes private copies.
musicDescription: Play your own local audio while writing. Files are copied into Dream Diary private storage; originals are never changed or deleted.
musicAndroidOnly: The music theme is available on Android.
musicBackgroundHint: Shows media controls while playing. Off: pause when the app goes to the background. Swiping the app away always stops playback.
musicEmpty: No tracks yet. Add MP3, M4A, AAC, OGG, Opus, FLAC, WAV or WebM files.
musicImportError: Some files could not be imported. Check format, permissions and size (up to 200 MB per file).
musicPlaybackError: This track could not be played. It may be missing, corrupted or unsupported. Remove it or add it again.
musicPlaylistError: The playlist could not be read. The private audio files were kept.
musicRemoveMessage: Remove "{title}" from the playlist and delete its private copy? The original file is kept.
musicNoAutoplay: Your playlist, current track and settings are restored. After reopening the app, the same track starts from the beginning; with PIN enabled, playback starts only after unlock. Normal pauses continue from where they stopped.
musicPrivacy: Private copies are not included in diary export/backup or sync. Clearing app data removes them.
